events.event: Mekari, an Indonesian HR/payroll software provider, suffered an outage on payday (25 November), drawing complaints from users on social media, per CNBC Indonesia.
events.key_numbers: Outage on 25 Nov 2026 (payday date) · duration and affected users not confirmed
events.why_it_matters: Payroll tools going down on payday can delay salary processing for many employees.

events.event: A US court found Huawei guilty of theft and fraud, per CNBC Indonesia headline.
events.key_numbers: Details of the ruling (damages, plaintiff) not verified
events.why_it_matters: Huawei is a major phone and HarmonyOS player also sold in Indonesia.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported that US President Trump's aides are distancing themselves from him after he strongly defended Jensen Huang amid the Nvidia CEO controversy.
events.why_it_matters: The Nvidia leadership saga keeps pulling in politics and affects AI chip supply and sentiment.

events.event: detikInet reported that the seven Anthropic founders' combined wealth has reached Rp3,289 trillion after the IPO.
events.key_numbers: Rp3,289 trillion combined (headline figure, not verified in article) · IPO price US$83 (E1114)
events.why_it_matters: A shock-size wealth number that makes the AI boom tangible, though shares have been trading near the IPO price.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported that OECD outlined five barriers to Indonesia joining global semiconductor supply chains.
events.why_it_matters: Shows why Indonesia still imports chips despite talk of a domestic chip industry.

events.event: detikInet reported that Meta's AI tool Muse caused staff unease by showing mysterious bank balances.
events.why_it_matters: Raises questions about AI assistants and access to private financial data.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia published a scam warning about a new mode of fraudsters posing as police to drain bank accounts, and an intelligence-agency and OJK tips piece on protecting phones and accounts.
events.key_numbers: Not verified (articles not opened) · IASC context: 743,589 accounts blocked, Rp967.5 billion victim funds saved (Bisnis, 5 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: Scam modes keep changing and directly put ordinary people's savings at risk.
